example.title: Laurell Building, NE Sycamore & 2nd Street (John Margolies Roadside America photo)

brief: Two-storey corner commercial block with an ornate pressed-metal upper front painted cream: a rounded corner turret-bay with tall one-over-one windows and a drum cap, paneled pilasters, dentil and bracketed cornice. The ground floor is a dark recessed storefront under a flat metal canopy hung on tie rods; plain red brick side wall with a ghost of an old painted sign. Second storefront continues along the street in the same block.
